The Roubic Bainbridge Township Story

Auburn-Adjacent Canopy Since 1982

Bainbridge Township is one of Roubic's flagship markets — and its closest Tier 2 city, just 3 miles from the Auburn Township yard. Many Bainbridge customers were Roubic's original neighbors when Thomas Roubic founded the company in 1982.

The trees that make Bainbridge look like Bainbridge — heritage oaks, mature maples, EAB-at-risk ash, and original-growth pines — are the trees we work on. It's a Geauga rural-suburban township of large residential lots and a mature mixed-hardwood canopy much like Auburn's.

A lot of Bainbridge families have been with us since the beginning. Same yard, same crew, same standards — 40 years later. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Common Bainbridge Township Questions

Bainbridge Township Tree Service FAQ

Six things Bainbridge Township homeowners want to know before booking.

Do you serve Bainbridge Township?
Yes — Bainbridge Township is part of Roubic's Tier 2 service area and our closest Tier 2 city, just 3 miles from the Auburn Township yard. We've served Bainbridge Township since 1982. Call {{global.phone}} for a free estimate.
How fast do you respond in Bainbridge Township?
Tier 2 markets like Bainbridge Township get next-day response on standard scheduled work and 2–4 hour response on emergencies from our Auburn Township yard. Our 24/7 emergency line is answered directly for storm calls.
Do I need a permit to remove a tree in Bainbridge Township?
Generally no — Bainbridge Township follows standard Geauga County rules, with no routine removal permit for trees on private property. Large-scale clearing may trigger zoning review. Roubic confirms permit requirements and coordinates any needed filing as part of every estimate.
How much does tree removal cost in Bainbridge Township?
Tree removal in Bainbridge Township typically runs $200–$10,000+ depending on tree size, species, access, and any permit fees. Small trees under 20 ft start around $200–$500; mature 50–80 ft trees run $1,500–$3,500; very large heritage estate trees needing crane assistance can exceed $10,000. Every estimate is free and confirmed on-site before you book.
Are you insured to work in Bainbridge Township?
Yes — Roubic is fully licensed and insured, carrying general liability and workers-comp coverage. A certificate of insurance is available on request and included in the estimate packet for jobs that require COI submission.
Can I schedule an estimate for a Bainbridge Township property?
Yes — click any Get Free Estimate button on this page (or call {{global.phone}}) with your Bainbridge Township address, the service needed, and your phone number. Aaron will confirm and schedule the on-site visit within 1 business day.
